welcome.title: Bienvenue dans Arenyxa V8.2.0
welcome.subtitle: Choose how you want to work first. This only changes workspace presentation and default navigation; it is not an authority level. Enterprise and developer identities are established through separate security flows.
welcome.scenario.title: Scénario d’accueil personnel
welcome.scenario.hint: When Personal Mode is selected, Arenyxa uses this scenario to configure the first home view. All personal features remain available afterward.
welcome.enterprise.title: Enterprise & Operations
welcome.enterprise.description: Enterprise work mode provides local enterprise identity, device enrollment and trust, LAN coordination, and workspace governance. Creating an enterprise establishes a separate enterprise identity; joining an existing enterprise requires a one-time device enrollment credential from an administrator.
welcome.fleet.title: Fleet Control
welcome.fleet.description: View Enterprise Server, Distributed Worker, parallel Slots, Jobs, Leases, storage topology, and health in one place. Fleet Control exposes only authorized runtime and operations views and does not change Enterprise authority boundaries.
welcome.note: You can reopen this separate window later from Settings → Work Mode. Themes, fonts, scaling, and motion remain on the separate Personalization page.
welcome.profile.personal.title: General User · Simple Mode
welcome.profile.personal.summary: Use guided tasks for network analysis, security checks, API debugging, and data work.
welcome.profile.personal.detail.1: Hide unnecessary professional navigation and advanced parameters
welcome.profile.personal.detail.2: Does not change any security permission
welcome.profile.power.title: Advanced User
welcome.profile.power.summary: Reach analysis, recovery, and advanced tools faster.
welcome.profile.professional.title: Professional Work
welcome.profile.professional.summary: For long-running automation, workflows, and data engineering.
welcome.profile.professional.detail.1: Keep full diagnostics and recovery entry points discoverable
welcome.profile.professional.detail.2: Authority is still decided by the Security Kernel
welcome.profile.developer.title: Developer Profile
welcome.profile.developer.summary: For public APIs, the plugin SDK, and developer workflows.
welcome.profile.developer.detail.1: High-risk capabilities still require a separate risk agreement
welcome.profile.developer.detail.2: This is not Official Developer Access
welcome.profile.enterprise.title: Enterprise Work Mode
welcome.profile.enterprise.summary: Open enterprise administration, device enrollment, and enterprise runtime workspaces.
welcome.profile.enterprise.detail.0: Show create/join entry points when no enterprise identity exists
welcome.profile.enterprise.detail.1: Mode selection does not grant enterprise authority
welcome.profile.enterprise.detail.2: Specific capabilities remain governed by the Security Kernel
personalization.title: Personnalisation
personalization.subtitle: Themes, interface material, motion, and scaling; use Settings for system and enterprise configuration.
personalization.themes.title: Préréglages visuels
personalization.themes.hint: Arenyxa visual presets affect appearance only; they do not change runtime behavior, permissions, storage, or enterprise policy.
personalization.motion.title: Matériau et mouvement
personalization.reduce_motion: Reduce large movement, refraction, particles, and continuous lighting effects
personalization.scale.title: Échelle de l’interface et typographie
personalization.scale.auto: Automatique (selon la taille de la fenêtre)
personalization.scale.hint: Automatic mode adjusts text and common control sizes according to Arenyxa's available window area while preserving Qt/Windows DPI scaling; Manual mode can be fixed from 85% to 160%.
personalization.scale.status_auto: Interface scaling updated: automatically follows window size
